ECOHeader.Name: Capacitor-X Substitution
ECOHeader.Synopsis: Substitute Capacitor-X (Part #CAP-X123) with Vendor-B's Capacitor (Part #CAP-Y456) due to EOL.
ECOHeader.Description: Detailed description of the ECO for Capacitor-X substitution on Cisco Catalyst 9300 motherboard.

Justification.ProblemDescription: The primary vendor for Capacitor-X (Part #CAP-X123) has issued an End-of-Life (EOL) notice effective Q4 2024. Current inventory will only support 3 weeks of production.
Justification.ProposedSolution: Substitute with Vendor-B Part #CAP-Y456. This component is a Form, Fit, and Function equivalent with verified electrical compatibility. Note: 2% higher voltage rating.
Justification.ImpactAnalysis: Traceability check shows this part is used in 14 active assemblies. Technical review confirms Part #CAP-Y456 meets Cisco Thermal Standard-7. No conflicts detected in high-heat Ruggedized Switch lines.
Justification.ComplianceStatement: This change is classified as Class II (Minor). It maintains UL Safety Certification and complies with Cisco Green Hardware initiative. No customer notification is required.
Justification.DispositionOfOldStock: Use existing stock of Part #CAP-X123 until exhausted (estimated Oct 15), then cut over to Part #CAP-Y456. No scrap required.

Item.ItemDescription: Original capacitor used in Cisco Catalyst 9300 motherboard

RiskAssessment.Rationale: 2% voltage variance requires thermal validation but within acceptable tolerance per Cisco standards.
